design.selection: quiz-weighted dev mean token F1; exact ties (rational arithmetic) broken toward CB, RAG, DATE_b by increasing b
design.cross_fitting: 20 repeats x 5 folds over sorted quiz ids shuffled with random.Random(20260917 + repeat), contiguous near-equal folds; per-question test F1 averaged over repeats
design.bootstrap: paired weekly-quiz bootstrap, B=5000, numpy default_rng(20260917) (rebuttal_common.QuizBoot); two-sided plus-one p; Holm across 9 generators on the quiz-weighted p
design.decision_rule: positive quiz-weighted difference with Holm p < 0.05 (equivalently the Holm step-level CI excludes 0) = audit changes the decision and improves held-out utility; identical selections or unresolved = decision unchanged or not resolved; negative = failure
design.scope: internal validation, not a prospective holdout; latency not claimed

full_sample_descriptive.label: in-sample means over all 878 questions; descriptive, not held-out

RAG_UNMASKED.note: unmasked hybrid; candidate only in the secondary leakage variant

oracle_max_CB_RAG.label: per-question max(CB, masked RAG): a descriptive ceiling that uses the answer; NOT an achievable policy

heldout_action_disagreement.note: held-out (question, repeat) instances where the audit and naive choices differ in whether retrieval is used; 0 means the selections differ at most in label

primary.estimand: cross-fitted F1(audit) - F1(naive), mean over 20 repeats per question

static.harm_check: Static F1 of each chosen procedure minus always-closed-book on the same Static questions (negative = retrieval-policy harm on Static)

leakage_variant.label: secondary
leakage_variant.question: Does the admissibility correction change the CB-vs-RAG choice?

masked_minus_unmasked.note: cross-fitted F1 of the naive procedure run on masked vs unmasked RAG outputs; unmasked outputs may use post-question evidence, so this is not a deployable utility contrast
